rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 43-61 ('## Why the LLM fabricates', 6 sub-mechanisms) and lines 63-84 ('## Why grounding fails even when the facts are in context', 4 sub-mechanisms) build a 10-mechanism causal model of fabrication and context-failure — this reads as *teaching* (mapping frameworks, explaining tradeoffs with reasons) rather than *arming* (spirit + one operational primitive). Per content-strategy, a dedicated lecture 'Why LLMs Will Always Fabricate' is still TODO and is specced to cover exactly this ground (statistical nature of generation, compound reliability math) — this prework already delivers a close cousin of that content ('It completes the shape' ≈ statistical-generation framing) ahead of both that lecture and the exercise's own discovery-based magic beat (five detectors, scoreboard fills in empirically).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Trim the two mechanism sections to the diagnostic lenses that matter for spotting a case in the two stories (not a full causal taxonomy); park the deeper mechanism explanations in the not-yet-written 'Why LLMs Will Always Fabricate' lecture where content-strategy already homes them.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity — consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, and mood-doesn't-resolve-early into one verdict.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Front-run facet: the two mechanism sections (see check_lectures §2 evidence) pre-empt ground the strategy doc homes in the still-unwritten M5 lecture, and dilute the exercise's designed 'magic beat' (five detectors, scoreboard empirically reveals which catches what) by pre-teaching the causal 'why' before the student ever runs the benchmark. Big Idea fidelity facet: PASS — 'the missing check' framing honors the Big Idea's discipline-of-groundedness spirit without borrowing its vocabulary prematurely (no 'grounded'/'ungrounded' language used, which correctly stays emergent-from-doing per the exercise's Concept line). rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Same fix as check_lectures §2/§5 — trimming the mechanism density resolves the one failing facet (front-run) without touching the three passing facets.

stealing_the_mood: Phase 1 (whole file): 7/10 — two stacked mechanism-dump sections (400w and 302w, both over the slide-size ceiling) read as theory-first rather than 'calibrate the eye'; not punitive, just denser than the stated job.

teaching_moment_lands.note: The homework asks the student to name 'the organisational check that would have caught this' in their own words for each case — but both cases already state that exact check verbatim in-body ('The missing check: one human opening the cited cases...' line 21; 'The missing check at Deloitte was not exotic: a reviewer opening each cited source...' line 37). A persona of any skill level can satisfy the close by paraphrasing a sentence already handed to them rather than deriving it from the case narrative — the reflection risks being copy-work, not synthesis. Fix belongs to the author (content-creation), not this judge: e.g. state the case facts without naming the check, and let 'name the missing check' be the first place the answer appears in the student's own words.
